Phase 1 — Build the Frontend Foundation You are a Senior Frontend Engineer. Build the foundation of a premium AI-powered UPSC Study Platform. Objective Create a scalable, production-ready frontend foundation using modern React architecture. Tech Stack Next.js (App Router) React TypeScript Tailwind CSS shadcn/ui Lucide React Framer Motion next-themes Important Rules Frontend only. Do NOT create: Backend API routes Authentication Database AI integration RAG Fake API calls Everything should use realistic local mock data. Folder Structure Use a feature-first architecture.
